en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ja’far Bin Ali who said,
‘I saw Abu Al-Hassanasws and heasws was prostrating after the Salāt. So heasws spread out hisasws arms upon the ground and paste hisasws chest upon the ground’.
en.sarwar: 14. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Ja‘far ibn Ali who has said the following: “
I saw abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, doing sajdah for after Salah (prayer), his arms spread on the ground and his chest and belly placed on the ground when praying.”
